Don-Jo Polished Brass 4 x 22 Plate with holes for a 8 Inch C.C. Pull

This custom size 4 inch x 22 inch polished brass commercial door pull plate has holes for an 8 inch center to center door pull. Made in the USA from .050 inch thick brass. Packaged with mounting hardware for easy installation.

Specifications of the Don-Jo 4" x 22" Push Plate with holes for #31 pull:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Finish: Polished Brass
  • Plate Height: 22"
  • Plate Width: 4"
  • 8" center to center prepration
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Packaged with Mounting Screws.

Special Ordered Item. Not Returnable
